verdict.rationale: Groq is a hosted inference API, and publishing its source under an open license is a fair question for such a product, so the axis applies. The pack only shows a public TypeScript client SDK repo, with no license stated, plus third-party open-weight models. Neither shows Groq's own product source available under an open license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
